name: McCulloch-Pitts neuron
title: A mathematical neuron
summary: A logical model connects simplified neurons with computation.
impact: Neural activity becomes a subject of formal computational analysis.

name: Turing test
title: The question that started it all
summary: Turing proposes the imitation game in Computing Machinery and Intelligence.
impact: It turns a philosophical question into a testable conversation.

name: Dartmouth workshop
title: Artificial intelligence gets a name
summary: The Dartmouth summer workshop establishes AI as a research field.
impact: A shared ambition becomes a new academic discipline.

name: Perceptron
title: The perceptron
summary: Rosenblatt describes a trainable model for pattern recognition.
impact: Learning from examples becomes a concrete computational approach.

name: Arthur Samuel's checkers program
title: Learning from a game of checkers
summary: Samuel publishes work on a checkers program that improves through experience.
impact: Machine learning becomes a concrete alternative to programming every decision.

name: DENDRAL expert system
title: Expertise becomes software
summary: DENDRAL applies encoded chemical expertise to molecular structure problems.
impact: Domain knowledge becomes a central route to useful AI.

name: ELIZA chatbot
title: A conversation with ELIZA
summary: Joseph Weizenbaum creates a program that simulates a psychotherapist.
impact: Simple language rules reveal how easily people attribute understanding to machines.

name: Shakey the robot
title: Shakey enters the world
summary: SRI begins the Shakey project, combining perception, planning, and movement in a mobile robot.
impact: AI moves from symbolic puzzles into a physical environment.

name: First AI winter
title: The first AI winter
summary: The Lighthill report challenges the progress of AI research in Britain.
impact: Unmet expectations contribute to a contraction in support.

name: Hopfield network
title: Memory as an energy landscape
summary: Hopfield links collective dynamics in networks to associative memory.
impact: Stable network states offer a computational model of recalling patterns.

name: Backpropagation
title: Learning by backpropagation
summary: A landmark paper demonstrates learning internal representations by propagating errors backward.
impact: Multilayer neural networks gain a practical training method.

name: Deep Blue vs Kasparov
title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov
summary: Deep Blue wins a six-game match against the reigning world chess champion.
impact: Machine competition reaches a highly visible human benchmark.

name: LSTM
title: Neural networks learn to remember
summary: Long short-term memory addresses the difficulty of learning dependencies across time.
impact: Gated memory becomes a major tool for sequence modeling.

name: Neural probabilistic language model
title: Words become learned representations
summary: A neural probabilistic language model learns word features and sequence probabilities together.
impact: Distributed representations offer a way to generalize beyond observed word combinations.

name: Deep belief networks
title: The deep learning revival
summary: Deep belief networks demonstrate a way to train multiple layers of features.
impact: The work helps renew interest in deep neural networks.

name: NVIDIA CUDA
title: GPUs become programmable compute
summary: CUDA’s public beta makes general-purpose GPU programming more accessible.
impact: A software ecosystem helps parallel hardware become practical for machine learning.

name: ImageNet
title: ImageNet changes the dataset
summary: ImageNet introduces a large, structured image database for visual recognition.
impact: A shared benchmark gives computer vision a new basis for comparison.

name: IBM Watson
title: Watson wins Jeopardy!
summary: IBM’s Watson wins a televised Jeopardy! exhibition against two champions.
impact: Language understanding becomes a public spectacle.

name: AlexNet
title: AlexNet transforms image recognition
summary: AlexNet wins the ImageNet competition using a deep convolutional network and GPUs.
impact: Deep learning rapidly becomes central to computer vision.

name: word2vec
title: Word relationships in vector space
summary: Efficient methods learn continuous representations of words from large corpora.
impact: Word vectors become a practical building block for language applications.

name: Deep Q-network
title: Learning to play from pixels
summary: A deep Q-network learns control policies directly from Atari screen input.
impact: Representation learning and reinforcement learning meet in a general experimental setup.

name: Variational autoencoder
title: Learning a generative latent space
summary: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes introduces a scalable approach to latent-variable learning.
impact: A probabilistic encoder-decoder becomes an influential generative building block.

name: Generative adversarial networks
title: Machines learn to imagine
summary: Generative adversarial networks pair a generator with a discriminator.
impact: A new framework makes realistic synthetic data a research frontier.

name: Sequence-to-sequence learning
title: One sequence becomes another
summary: An encoder-decoder system learns to map variable-length sequences to other sequences.
impact: A general interface emerges for translation and other structured language tasks.

name: Adam optimizer
title: Adam changes the training toolkit
summary: Adam introduces adaptive stochastic optimization using gradient moment estimates.
impact: A broadly reusable optimizer becomes part of the standard deep-learning toolkit.

name: ResNet
title: Depth without the degradation
summary: Residual learning makes very deep networks easier to optimize.
impact: Skip connections become a foundational design pattern across deep learning.

name: OpenAI
title: OpenAI is founded
summary: OpenAI announces a research organization focused on artificial intelligence.
impact: A new lab becomes part of the growing frontier-AI ecosystem.

name: AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol
title: Move 37. A new kind of intuition.
summary: AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol 4–1 in their five-game Go match.
impact: The match demonstrates the power of learning combined with search.

name: Transformer
title: Attention is all you need
summary: The Transformer paper introduces an attention-based architecture without recurrence.
impact: It provides the architectural foundation for many modern language models.

name: AlphaZero
title: Mastery through self-play
summary: AlphaZero learns strong play in chess, shogi, and Go through self-play.
impact: A shared learning approach works across several complex board games.

name: GPT-1
title: The first GPT
summary: Generative pre-training shows how a language model can transfer to downstream tasks.
impact: Pre-train first, adapt later becomes an influential recipe.

name: BERT
title: BERT reads both ways
summary: BERT introduces bidirectional pre-training for language understanding.
impact: Context from both directions improves a range of language tasks.

name: GPT-2
title: GPT-2 and the release debate
summary: GPT-2 demonstrates stronger long-form text generation with a staged release.
impact: The release brings questions about misuse into the model-launch process.

name: T5
title: Every language task is text-to-text
summary: T5 systematically studies transfer learning within a unified text-to-text framework.
impact: Shared interfaces make models, objectives, and datasets easier to compare.

name: GPT-3
title: GPT-3 scales up
summary: GPT-3 demonstrates few-shot learning across a broad collection of language tasks.
impact: Examples in a prompt can guide behavior without task-specific fine-tuning.

name: DDPM
title: Learning to reverse noise
summary: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models demonstrate high-quality image synthesis.
impact: Iterative denoising becomes a major route to generative media.

name: Vision Transformer
title: Images become patch sequences
summary: Vision Transformer applies a Transformer to sequences of image patches.
impact: Attention-centered architectures extend into mainstream image recognition.

name: AlphaFold 2
title: A 50-year biology problem
summary: AlphaFold 2 achieves a breakthrough in protein structure prediction at CASP14.
impact: Predicted structures become a powerful resource for biological research.

name: DALL·E
title: DALL·E: language becomes image
summary: DALL·E explores image generation from natural-language descriptions.
impact: Text becomes an interface for creating visual concepts.

name: GitHub Copilot
title: Your AI pair programmer
summary: GitHub introduces the Copilot technical preview.
impact: Code generation moves directly into the developer’s editor.

name: Latent diffusion models
title: Diffusion leaves pixel space
summary: Latent diffusion reduces the cost of high-resolution image generation.
impact: Compressed representations help make powerful image models more practical.

name: InstructGPT
title: Learning what users prefer
summary: InstructGPT studies instruction following with human feedback.
impact: Preference-based post-training becomes central to useful language assistants.

name: Chinchilla scaling laws
title: Scale the data, not just the model
summary: Chinchilla revisits the balance between model size and training data at fixed compute.
impact: Compute-optimal scaling becomes a central training-design question.

name: DALL·E 2
title: DALL·E 2
summary: DALL·E 2 introduces improved image generation and editing.
impact: Generative imagery becomes more usable for visual exploration.

name: Stable Diffusion
title: Stable Diffusion opens up
summary: Stable Diffusion is publicly released with downloadable model weights.
impact: Image generation can run outside a single hosted service.

name: ChatGPT release
title: Hello, ChatGPT.
summary: A research preview puts conversational AI into everyone’s hands.
impact: A simple chat interface turns language models into an everyday tool, accelerating public adoption and a new wave of products.

name: LLaMA
title: LLaMA enters the picture
summary: Meta releases the first LLaMA research models with controlled access.
impact: Smaller research models expand experimentation beyond the largest labs.

name: GPT-4
title: GPT-4 raises the bar
summary: GPT-4 launches with stronger capabilities and image-input research.
impact: Multimodal language models move closer to practical use across writing, coding, and analysis.

name: Claude release
title: Meet Claude
summary: Anthropic introduces its Claude assistant.
impact: A new model family brings a distinct focus on helpfulness and safety.

name: Segment Anything
title: A foundation model for segmentation
summary: Segment Anything introduces promptable image segmentation and a large mask dataset.
impact: Visual selection becomes a reusable model capability.

name: Llama 2
title: Llama 2 opens commercial access
summary: Meta releases Llama 2 under a license allowing many commercial uses.
impact: Downloadable weights make self-hosted AI more accessible, subject to license conditions.

name: Mistral 7B
title: A smaller open-weight contender
summary: Mistral 7B releases a compact language model under Apache 2.0.
impact: Permissively licensed models broaden the practical self-hosting field.

name: Bletchley Declaration
title: The Bletchley Declaration
summary: Participating countries publish a shared declaration on frontier AI risks.
impact: AI safety becomes a subject of formal international coordination.

name: Google Gemini
title: The Gemini era begins
summary: Google introduces Gemini, a family of multimodal models.
impact: Google reorganizes its assistant and developer offerings around a new model family.

name: OpenAI Sora
title: Sora imagines in motion
summary: OpenAI previews a text-to-video model that generates complex moving scenes.
impact: Video becomes a major new frontier for generative modeling.

name: Claude 3
title: Claude 3 arrives
summary: Anthropic introduces the Claude 3 model family, including Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku.
impact: Multiple model sizes offer different capability and speed tradeoffs.

name: AlphaFold 3
title: AlphaFold 3 expands the picture
summary: AlphaFold 3 predicts structures and interactions across different types of biomolecules.
impact: The scope expands beyond proteins to molecular interactions.

name: GPT-4o
title: GPT-4o: a more natural interface
summary: GPT-4o introduces a model designed for text, vision, and audio.
impact: Multimodal interaction moves toward conversational speed.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
summary: Claude 3.5 Sonnet launches alongside the Artifacts preview.
impact: The assistant gains a dedicated space for working with generated outputs.

name: Llama 3.1
title: A frontier-scale downloadable model
summary: Llama 3.1 expands the family with a 405B model and updated smaller variants.
impact: Self-hosted development gains another frontier-scale option.

name: EU AI Act
title: The EU AI Act enters into force
summary: The European Union’s AI Act enters into force with phased implementation.
impact: A broad, risk-based regulatory framework begins its rollout.

name: OpenAI o1
title: Thinking before answering
summary: The o1-preview release introduces a reasoning-focused model series.
impact: More computation at inference time becomes a visible model capability.

name: Hopfield and Hinton Nobel Prize
title: Neural networks win a Nobel
summary: John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton receive the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics for foundational work enabling machine learning with neural networks.
impact: Decades of neural-network research receive recognition at the highest level of science.

name: AlphaFold Nobel Prize
title: AI meets the Nobel in Chemistry
summary: Demis Hassabis and John Jumper share half the chemistry prize for protein structure prediction; David Baker receives the other half for computational protein design.
impact: AI’s contribution to scientific discovery is recognized alongside computational protein design.

name: Claude computer use
title: Claude uses a computer
summary: Anthropic releases computer use in public beta.
impact: Models begin interacting with software through screenshots and input actions.

name: Model Context Protocol
title: A common language for tools
summary: The Model Context Protocol is introduced as an open standard.
impact: A shared connection layer helps applications expose tools and context to assistants.

name: DeepSeek-R1
title: DeepSeek-R1 opens reasoning
summary: DeepSeek-R1 releases reasoning-model weights and distilled variants.
impact: Strong downloadable reasoning models broaden access and intensify the efficiency debate.

name: Claude Code
title: Claude Code enters the terminal
summary: Claude 3.7 Sonnet launches with a research preview of Claude Code.
impact: Agentic coding becomes an increasingly direct, terminal-based workflow.

name: Gemini 2.5
title: Gemini makes thinking explicit
summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental emphasizes reasoning before a response.
impact: Inference-time reasoning spreads across major model providers.

name: Qwen3
title: Qwen 3 broadens open reasoning
summary: Qwen 3 releases dense and mixture-of-experts models with thinking and non-thinking modes.
impact: Downloadable multilingual reasoning models expand deployment choices.

name: Claude 4
title: Claude 4 gets to work
summary: Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4 launch alongside general availability of Claude Code.
impact: Coding and extended agentic work take center stage in the model family.

name: gpt-oss
title: OpenAI returns to open weights
summary: OpenAI releases gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b reasoning models.
impact: Developers gain downloadable models under Apache 2.0 from another major provider.

name: GPT-5
title: GPT-5 arrives
summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5 with a unified ChatGPT experience.
impact: The product combines fast responses and deeper reasoning in one system.

name: Gemini 3
title: Gemini 3
summary: Google launches Gemini 3 with reasoning and multimodal improvements.
impact: The model reaches search, the Gemini app, and developer tools.

name: Claude Opus 4.6
title: Claude Opus 4.6
summary: Anthropic introduces Opus 4.6, extending its flagship model’s coding and professional-work capabilities.
impact: The model family continues its shift toward larger, more involved agentic tasks.

name: Claude Sonnet 5
title: Claude Sonnet 5
summary: Anthropic introduces Sonnet 5 for coding, agents, and professional work.
impact: The release extends the company’s focus on everyday agentic workflows.

name: AI Act enforcement
title: AI Act enforcement expands
summary: The European Commission announces enforcement and transparency requirements from August 2.
impact: Regulation moves further from legislative design into operational obligations.

name: GPT-6 Astra
title: Astra: the next frontier
summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Astra, emphasizing computer use, coding, science, and professional work.
impact: The release places increasingly capable agents at the center of the frontier-model conversation.
